images.filename: Correct View of the Battle Near the City of New Orleans.jpg
images.caption:
A Correct view of the battle near the city of New Orleans ... / Francisco Scachi.
Early published engraving of the battle at Chalmette, Louisiana, 1815.

Print shows a battlefield scene. In the foreground, critically wounded British General Edward Pakenham is held by his officers. A cameo portrait of Andrew Jackson is below the image along with text describing the battle.
